lines.text: Why are video screenshots sometimes black?
It's not a bug: the app marks its video window as secure.
That's because films are protected, so phones leave secure windows out of screenshots.
Which means your screenshot is black, while the film keeps playing.
Takeaway: a black screenshot means protected, not broken.

post.title: Why are video screenshots sometimes black?
post.caption:
Why do screenshots of some videos come out black? 🎬

It's not a bug. Streaming apps mark the window that plays the film as secure, because the film is protected content. Your phone then leaves secure windows out of screenshots (Android's own developer docs say so word for word), so the picture you save is black while the film keeps playing. A black screenshot means protected, not broken: your phone is fine.
Send this to the friend who thinks their screenshot button broke.

sources.note: Android Developers, WindowManager.LayoutParams FLAG_SECURE: "treat the content of the window as secure, preventing it from appearing in screenshots or from being viewed on non-secure displays"
Android Developers, SurfaceView.setSecure: the surface (the video layer) can be treated as secure, so its content does not appear in screenshots
Apple, FairPlay Streaming: content providers encrypt content, exchange keys securely and protect playback on Apple platforms
